verdict.label: Easy
verdict.oneLiner: Public distribution is instant; the optional Marketplace listing takes weeks and needs 5+ active workspaces first.
verdict.s2Limit: Unlisted apps may get tighter API rate limits (unverified)

steps.title: Draft the app manifest
steps.detail: List the bot and user scopes you need and the redirect URL.
steps.agentAction: Generate a manifest from your feature list.

steps.title: Create the app from the manifest
steps.detail: Use Create New App, From a manifest.

steps.title: Install to your workspace and run OAuth
steps.detail: Run the OAuth v2 flow once and store the tokens server-side.

steps.title: Enable public distribution
steps.detail: Activate distribution and install into a second workspace.

steps.title: Prepare Marketplace listing materials
steps.detail: Draft listing copy, support and privacy links, and a test plan for reviewers.
steps.agentAction: Draft listing text and review answers.

steps.title: Reach 5+ active workspaces
steps.detail: Marketplace submission needs real usage first.

steps.title: Wait for Marketplace review (optional)
steps.detail: Preliminary then functional review. Docs give upper bounds only.

blockers.cause: The redirect_uri differs from one saved in the app settings.
blockers.fix: Add the exact URL under OAuth & Permissions > Redirect URLs.

claims.text: Marketplace review: preliminary review up to 10 business days, functional review up to 10 weeks for new apps.

evidence.note: Checked against the linked page on 2026-10-27.

claims.text: An app must be installed on 5+ active workspaces before Marketplace submission (third-party quoting Slack).

evidence.note: Checked against the linked page on 2026-10-27.

claims.text: Each resubmission resets the preliminary-review queue position.

evidence.note: Checked against the linked page on 2026-10-27.

claims.text: After listing, config, scopes and endpoints are locked; changes need re-review.

evidence.note: Checked against the linked page on 2026-10-27.
